concept.promise_zh: 让每项AI创新经过技术基准、公共可达与真实采纳三道可见门槛。
concept.promise_en: Every AI innovation passes three visible thresholds: technical benchmark, civic access and real adoption.

global_cases.title: one-north, Singapore
global_cases.mechanism: Work-live-play-learn mix and community-building public realm.
global_cases.transfer_limit: Transfer open interfaces and community programming; do not transfer dimensions.

global_cases.title: Kendall Square / Volpe, Cambridge
global_cases.mechanism: Active ground floors, public open space and review conditions.
global_cases.transfer_limit: Transfer public-edge accountability, not zoning quantities.

global_cases.title: 22@ Barcelona
global_cases.mechanism: Innovation clustering linked with district conversion.
global_cases.transfer_limit: Transfer phased conversion logic; no copied imagery or parcel controls.

global_cases.title: Knowledge Quarter London
global_cases.mechanism: A one-mile membership network with access, identity and knowledge exchange.

global_cases.title: STATION F, Paris
global_cases.mechanism: Share / Create / Chill program zones and public-facing campus experience.
global_cases.transfer_limit: Transfer program legibility, not building form.

global_cases.title: MaRS Discovery District, Toronto
global_cases.mechanism: Startups, corporates, research labs and venture/adoption support together.
global_cases.transfer_limit: Transfer translation services and adoption network.

personas.need_zh: 可测试接口、贡献署名、低成本临时工位
personas.need_en: Test interfaces, contribution credit, low-cost temporary workspace

personas.need_zh: 合规、算力、场景、客户与融资转译
personas.need_en: Compliance, compute, scenarios, customers and finance translation

personas.need_zh: 安全可控的真实场景验证和标准接口
personas.need_en: Governable real-world validation and standards interface

personas.need_zh: 安静、遮荫、可解释服务与明确退出
personas.need_en: Quiet, shade, explainable service and clear exit

personas.need_zh: 成果转译、公共发布、跨校慢行和国际交流
personas.need_en: Translation, public release, campus links and exchange

personas.zh: 老人、残障者与低数字熟练者
personas.need_zh: 全程无障碍、人工服务、非智能替代和可读提示
personas.need_en: Step-free route, human service, non-digital alternative and legible notices
